propositions: Plan-review evidence-kind criterion failed to block a repository-fact AC tagged [operator-attested] on epic fb8a-7363-e406-4e36, allowing laundered attestation to pass despite repo-verifiable proof existing in tests/unit/test_scan_scoping.py.

Completion verifier accepted the [operator-attested] tag at face value per ADR-0043 design; no deterministic blocking guard existed on the close path to reject code-verifiable ACs with operator-attestation tags.
det_measurement_provenance correctly detected missing provenance continuation lines on tagged ACs but was wired as ADVISORY (p6_ac_quality contract), preventing close-path rejection.

A new deterministic pre-LLM detector (det_attestation_launder.py) must fire on the close path to reject [operator-attested] ACs whose text cites exact repository paths/symbols (repo-root-anchored paths, slash-notation code files, pytest node IDs, bare test_* symbols), with commits/Gerrit numbers deliberately excluded per ADR-0043 provenance semantics.

Close-path guard txn.ensure_attested_items_valid must block laundering (report first), missing/incomplete provenance lines (det_measurement_provenance promoted to blocking for close only), and coach SPLIT of mixed criteria (repo evidence untagged, external evidence tagged with provenance).
